pokedexEntries.su: The bones it possesses were once its mother’s. Its mother’s regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

pokedexEntries.us: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

pokedexEntries.um: When it beats opponents with its bone, the cursed flames spread to them. No amount of water will stop those flames from burning.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: It has transformed the spirit of its dear departed mother into flames, and tonight it will once again dance in mourning of others of its kind.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

pokedexEntries.sh: The cursed flames that light up the bone carried by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental and physical pain that will never fade.
